name: National Authority for Child Care (NACC) & Regional Alternative Child Care Offices
descriptionEn: Lead quasi-judicial government agency handling domestic administrative adoption, relative adoption, foster care licensing, and CDCLAA applications under RA 11642.
descriptionFil: Pangunahing ahensya ng gobyerno na nangangasiwa sa domestic administrative adoption, relative adoption, foster care, at CDCLAA sa ilalim ng RA 11642.
whereToVisit: Regional Alternative Child Care Office (RACCO) in your region or coordinate via your City/Municipal LSWDO.
verificationNote: Verify current regional office address and intake schedule via the official NACC website.

name: Public Attorney's Office (PAO)
coverage: Nationwide (District Offices in Bataan & all provinces)
descriptionEn: Provides free legal counseling, notarization of affidavits, and court representation (such as judicial guardianship or Rule 108 petitions) to qualified indigent Filipinos.
descriptionFil: Nagbibigay ng libreng payong legal, notaryo ng affidavit, at representasyon sa korte sa mga kwalipikadong indigent na Pilipino.
whereToVisit: PAO District Office usually located at the Hall of Justice or Provincial/City Capitol compound.
verificationNote: Bring Barangay Certificate of Indigency and proof of income; eligibility is subject to PAO Indigency and Merit Tests.

name: Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD)
coverage: Nationwide (Field Office III covers Central Luzon / Bataan)
descriptionEn: Provides social welfare programs, crisis intervention (AICS), child protection referrals, and coordination with Local Social Welfare Offices.
descriptionFil: Nagbibigay ng programang panlipunan, tulong pinansyal sa krisis (AICS), at referral para sa proteksyon ng bata.
whereToVisit: DSWD Regional Field Office or Social Welfare and Development (SWAD) Provincial Team.
verificationNote: Confirm program eligibility and office hours directly on dswd.gov.ph or at your LSWDO.

name: Local Social Welfare and Development Offices (Bataan Community Guide & Nationwide LGUs)
coverage: Every City & Municipality (e.g., Balanga City & Bataan Municipalities)
descriptionEn: Your closest frontline government office for child welfare intake, Social Case Study Reports, Solo Parent ID assessment (RA 11861), and referrals to RACCO/NACC.
descriptionFil: Pinakamalapit na opisina sa munisipyo o lungsod para sa paunang pagtatasa ng social worker, Social Case Study Report, Solo Parent ID, at referral sa NACC.
whereToVisit: City Hall or Municipal Hall (Social Welfare Office) in your locality.
verificationNote: Independent community directory entry; visit your city/municipal hall directly to confirm intake days and required barangay endorsements.

name: Local Civil Registry Office (City / Municipal Civil Registrar)
descriptionEn: Handles birth registration, late registration, Certificate of Foundling recording, RA 9048/10172 clerical corrections, and RA 9255 surname acknowledgment.
descriptionFil: Nangangasiwa sa pagpaparehistro ng kapanganakan, late registration, Certificate of Foundling, at pagtatama sa ilalim ng RA 9048/10172.
whereToVisit: Local Civil Registry Office at the City or Municipal Hall where the birth occurred or where you reside.
verificationNote: Confirm exact municipal filing fees and documentary checklists at your local City/Municipal Hall.

name: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) – Civil Registration & E-Certificate Services
descriptionEn: Issues security-paper copies and digitally signed PSA E-Certificates (PDF with QR verification under PSA MC No. 2026-10) for Birth, Marriage, Death, and CENOMAR records.
descriptionFil: Naglalabas ng opisyal na PSA security-paper copies at digitally signed PSA E-Certificates (PDF na may QR verification) para sa Birth, Marriage, Death, at CENOMAR.
whereToVisit: PSA Civil Registry System (CRS) Outlets, eGovPH superapp, or official PSAHelpline portal.
verificationNote: Use only official PSA outlets or verified government portals; check whether your receiving agency requires physical security paper or accepts digital E-Certificates.

name: Integrated Bar of the Philippines (IBP) – National Center for Legal Aid & Provincial Chapters
descriptionEn: Provides free legal consultations and pro bono legal assistance to qualified indigent litigants through local IBP provincial chapters.
descriptionFil: Nagbibigay ng libreng konsultasyong legal at pro bono na tulong sa mga kwalipikadong indigent sa pamamagitan ng mga provincial chapter ng IBP.
whereToVisit: IBP Provincial Chapter Office (often at the Hall of Justice) or via IBP National Center for Legal Aid.
verificationNote: Confirm walk-in consultation schedules directly with your local IBP chapter.
